release_highlights: Registered rule catalog remains 87 rules: 86 contests + 1 QSO Party.
QSL/JCC-JCG batch handling and QSL quick-processing support include QRZ.R and CARD.R.
JCG code-only location can resolve to county (gun) level without guessing a municipality.
JCC/JCG award-check view supports async loading, prefecture folding, per-band worked/QSL status, and remaining CFM counts.
Amateur log discovery is centralized; logbook_flr is reserved/protected for future free-radio support and excluded from amateur aggregation.
EASY tabs are limited to two and use a dedicated two-page large-text workflow over the same PSLog master storage.
About screen documents PS = Pipe Separate.
